explanation: The binary URI acquisition passed, but a generic location helper decoded escaped characters inside the opaque handle before content/metadata requests. The resulting invalid handles caused null content and command errors. The corrected implementation returns the original URI byte-for-byte; regressions use the observed escaped form. These raw failures are not attributed to server correctness.
